score: w0*new_levels + w1*new_holes + w2*covers_ready - w3*well_benefit + w4*height_cost + w5*roughness + w6*high

training.method: cross-entropy method on capped survival from empty boards
training.initialization: zero-mean isotropic Gaussian in theta (std 1); no preset coefficients, signs or priorities
training.fitness: mean placements survived over the generation's fresh training seeds; capped games add cap*0.05*(16-final max height)/16 - final holes
training.selection_rule: first CEM mean whose 200,000-placement screening probe on seed 71000002 (not a training or verification seed) stayed hole-free with bounded occupancy
